drivingQuestion: How much greening of a bird's singed innards renders it a tereifa?
outcomeNote: A single transmitted ruling attached to the mishna's clause, with no question, attack or answer.

segments.he: נָפְלָה לָאוּר, אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן מִשּׁוּם רַבִּי יוֹסֵי בֶּן יְהוֹשֻׁעַ: שִׁיעוּר יְרוּקָּתָן כְּשִׁיעוּר נְקוּבָתָן, מָה נְקוּבָתָן בְּמַשֶּׁהוּ – אַף יְרוּקָּתָן בְּמַשֶּׁהוּ.
segments.en: § The mishna states: In a case where a bird «fell into the fire» and its innards were singed, if they turned green the bird is a tereifa; if they are red the bird is kosher. «Rabbi Yoḥanan says in the name of Rabbi Yosei ben Yehoshua: The measure of their» turning «green is like the measure of their perforation. Just as their perforation in any amount» renders them a tereifa, «so too their turning green in any amount» renders them a tereifa.
